[.verse-line]
[.i149]##{nbsp}##‘Ev’n while the reaper fills his greedy hands,
[.i149]##{nbsp}##‘And binds the golden sheafs in brittle bands:
[.i146]##{nbsp}##‘Oft have I seen a sudden storm arise
[.i146]##{nbsp}##‘From all the warring winds that sweep the skies;
[.i144]##{nbsp}##‘And oft whole sheets descend of slucy rain,
[.i146]##{nbsp}##‘Suck’d by the spungy clouds from off the main;
[.i149]##{nbsp}##‘The lofty skies at once come pouring down,
[.i144]##{nbsp}##‘The promis’d crop and golden labours drown.
